title: FiduciaEffects
description: Approval-escrow effect payloads: separate preparing a dangerous side effect from authorizing and committing it, so a risky action is performed at most once and only after approval.

EffectPrepareRequest.title: EffectPrepareRequest
EffectPrepareRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/effects/prepare. Idempotent: a repeat prepare returns the existing effect. required_approvals of 0 is pre-approved.

effect_type.description: Kind of side effect, such as send_payment or deploy.

risk.description: Risk label, such as low/medium/high/critical. Defaults to medium.

idempotency_key.description: Binds the effect to the external operation so the executor stays effectively-once.

required_approvals.description: Distinct principals required before commit. Defaults to 0.

EffectApproveRequest.title: EffectApproveRequest
EffectApproveRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/effects/approve. Duplicate approvals by the same principal count once.

EffectCommitRequest.title: EffectCommitRequest
EffectCommitRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/effects/commit. Commits an approved effect exactly once; a repeat commit replays the recorded result.

result.description: Durable result to record for replay.

EffectState.title: EffectState
EffectState.description: Current effect state returned by GET /v1/effects.
